tests.name: orb active-provider (orb route module) still answers

tests.reason: The fix is telemetry on session END and on OASIS insert shape. Producing a real stop or provider-selected row needs a real ORB voice session, which writes to the production Supabase project, so staging probes (read-only, anonymous) cannot create one. These suites prove the SSE close path emits the stop and records the facts end exactly once, that every liveSessions.delete is preceded by a stop emit (mutation-verified), and that an event missing service/status/message is skipped and logged loudly instead of failing silently. After PUBLISH, a read-only oasis_events count of vtid.live.session.start vs .stop by metadata->>'transport', and of orb.upstream.provider.selected, confirms it.
Standing regression suites (CLAUDE.md 42c/42e/42h) stay green; the change touches orb-live.ts and the shared OASIS emitter.
